_comment: file-ownership baseline — layered ruling (owner 2026-09-28, carrying over Phase 1/2a): the CLI writes aimail_gateway.json (system-level env), the SDK writes agentmail.json (per-agent binding); the reverse direction is read-only. Rule = no new additions: a hit identity = file::rule::write-call-kind::source-line-fragment (line numbers drift, fragments do not), only shrinking is allowed, never growing; any new out-of-bounds write ⇒ rc=1. **Currently empty** — after ruling A landed (2026-09-28) all 6 CLI-side binding write call sites moved to the pysdk semantic thin functions (update_binding/backfill_binding/rename_binding), and the 2 old 'precision false positives' switched to the inline escape hatch file-ownership-allowed (printed as a separate section). Empty baseline = any new out-of-bounds write immediately rc=1; --strict now judges the same as the default.
